title: Char Dham Yatra: 12 Days to Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath & Badrinath
card_points: All four Himalayan dhams in one journey
Treks to Yamunotri & Kedarnath, with pony and helicopter options
overview: The Char Dham Yatra is one of Hinduism’s most revered pilgrimages: four shrines high in the Garhwal Himalaya, at the sources of the Yamuna and the Ganga, the Jyotirlinga of Kedarnath and the abode of Lord Vishnu at Badrinath.

This twelve-day journey starts and ends on the Ganga at Haridwar and Rishikesh, with a private vehicle, a tour manager, all meals and stays near each dham. The route is long and mountainous, so we pace it with early starts, rest stops and time to acclimatise.

highlights.title: Kedarnath

highlights.title: Badrinath
highlights.text: Shrine of Lord Badri Vishal on the Alaknanda

good_to_know.title: Dress code
good_to_know.text: Traditional or modest clothing is recommended at all temples. Footwear is removed before entering.

good_to_know.title: What to carry
good_to_know.text: A valid photo ID, comfortable walking shoes, a water bottle and any regular medication.

good_to_know.title: Fitness & altitude
good_to_know.text: The route reaches 3,583 m at Kedarnath and includes two long treks. A basic fitness routine and a doctor’s check-up are advised; ponies, palkis and helicopters can be arranged.

good_to_know.title: Best time to visit
good_to_know.text: The temples open around late April or May and close around October–November; exact dates are announced each year. Avoid the peak monsoon weeks of July and August.

faqs.question: Where does the tour start and end?
faqs.answer: The tour starts in Haridwar and ends with a drop-off at Haridwar or Dehradun airport.

faqs.question: Is the yatra suitable for senior citizens?
faqs.answer: Yes, with planning. Ponies, palkis and helicopter services can replace the treks. Tell us about any health conditions so we can advise.

faqs.question: Is registration required?
faqs.answer: Yes, the Uttarakhand government requires yatra registration for every pilgrim. Our team helps you complete it.

faqs.question: Can I do only Do Dham (Kedarnath & Badrinath)?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can plan a shorter Do Dham itinerary of around 6–7 days.
